summary: Implement npm/node-semver range matching (satisfies, max_satisfying) in pure Python.
what_tests_check: Caret/tilde on 0.x and partial versions, x-ranges, partial comparators (>1.2, <=1), hyphen ranges with partial ends, unions, prerelease exclusion rule and identifier precedence, invalid inputs, numeric max selection; all expectations verified against real node-semver.
